title: news eval draft
description: Draft what Karthik labels in Board: the stored outputs the A12 judges are checked on (G6 pages and any G1 outputs a version stored) and G3 story pairs, a candidate and a story either side of Taster's join threshold, from the embeddings already stored. It drafts items only and never a label; running it again adds only what is new. Input is the command's arguments as an object; output is the envelope's data.

pairs.description: How many story pairs to draft (default 200, G3's target)
